method: BASELINE. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

scope: From the member's seat: s 10(1), (2) (eligibility age, the Act's own 65 and 60); s 12(1), (2) and s 13(1), (1A) (unclaimed money, the fund's duty to try to reach me); ss 14, 15(1) (a member who has died); s 20QA(1), (1A) (inactive low-balance account); s 24B (lost member account; 'lost member' asked as a fact); s 20AA(1) (former temporary resident); the days by which my fund must pay the Commissioner under ss 17(1), 20E(2), 20F(1), 20QD(1), 21C(2), 24E(1), and s 22 (voluntary); whom the Commissioner must pay under ss 17(1C)-(2AAB), 20QF(1)-(3), 21E(1)-(3), 22B(1)-(3), 24G(1)-(2A), with the death beneficiaries' share only for one beneficiary; interest due under ss 17(2AB)-(2AE), 20QF(5)-(6), 21E(5)-(6), 22B(5)-(6), 24G(3A)-(3D) (whether, not how much); s 20H(1)-(3) (former temporary resident); s 24NA(1)-(2) (transfer to my active account; s 24NA(3) not covered); recovery of overpayments from me under ss 20L, 20QK, 21G, 22E, 24K and s 24NAA; objection under s 20P. Out: the statements and their errors beyond their due days; the amount formulas (s 17(1A), the death-beneficiary formulas, lost in conversion) and the s 20F(2)-(4) amount; State, Territory and prescribed public sector schemes (ss 18, 18AA, 20JA, 20QG, 20QH, 22D, 24H, 24HA); refunds and repayments between providers and the Commissioner; s 20J except as an objectionable decision; s 20H(2A)-(2C) (pre-2013 interest); registers, tax file numbers, records, penalty amounts and the machinery (Parts 1, 5, 6; ss 19, 20, 20N, 23, 24, 24M).
seat: the member of a superannuation fund, approved deposit fund or RSA; where a member has died, the person entitled to the benefit (a death beneficiary or the legal personal representative); for s 12(2), the non-member spouse under a payment split
